answer: Each identity maintains one distinct live fermentation vat in a community garden shed across the north bridge, feeding it daily and posting its temperature log weekly. Verifiers sample quarterly; a lab sequences the culture and checks its pigment shift against the registered fingerprint, and a missed feeding or matched sequence revokes the slot. Setup is $140 per vat plus $90 per lab test, so 1,000 Sybils need 1,000 separate vats and $230,000 yearly, and cannot copy a culture that drifts uniquely. Trade-off: cultures die easily, so honest keepers risk false loss.
